title: Keagan Hoffman Drops new single "2 Pills" feat. Caspr
htmlContent:
American-based hip-hop star Keagan Hoffman is a multitalented rapper and lyrical genius who aims to shine light through music authentically. Keagan Hoffman's debut single, "2 Pills" feat. Caspr gives his fans a seamless experience when listening to his collection of hype tracks while also inspiring them to follow their God-given potential.

Keagan Hoffman and Caspr's "2 Pills" is an ultra smash that delivers the music and takes it over the top in its sound to make a one-of-a-kind experience that you will not be able to get enough of. Keagan Hoffman's captivating and high-energy performances allow the audience to experience God on a whole new level in a positive yet exciting environment.
